text:
emma: incident-bot just flagged an SLO burn after the 12:03 deploy to prod. Seeing elevated p99 latency and a handful of customer 500s. Not sure of scope yet. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • Sev 2 • incident:1999990001 • page: @oncall-eng • automated-slo-alert (latency_p99 > 1.5s)

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.15-12:03 to service 'inference-router' finished at 12:04:21. Canary: 5% -> 20% -> 100% (auto-promote).

raj: I'm on it. pulling up canary vs prod metrics now. quick q: did we change the routing policy in this release?

emma: yes, we switched default routing to prefer cheap-variant-2 for non-priority customers. config PR #4321.

jamie: i can confirm increased error rate on the cheap-variant-2 route — spike in 500s from model runtime OOMs? logs look like kv-cache failures.

linda: heads up, the new latency dashboard tile for "variant routing latencies" didn't get created in Grafana for this release. I searched the dashboards and only the canary panel exists in staging.

mike: ugh ok that's a big gap. our pager rule references that tile for triage context. if it's missing, paging will be noisy and handoff will be blind.

raj: can someone dump the raw metrics from Prom for the last 15m? i want to compare p99 across variants.

emma: pasted query: `sum(rate(requests{job=\"inference-router\"}[$__range])) by (variant)` — but i'm seeing an odd tag: `variant=~\"cheap-.*\"` returns high latency buckets.

jamie: raw sample from logs: ``ERROR inference-worker: failed to allocate KV cache: cuda out of memory`` — repeated during the rollout window.

linda: deploy-bot, can you attach the rollout diff?
deploy-bot: PR #4321 diff: changed default routing weight cheap-variant-2 from 20->60, added autoscale floor 2->1 for cheap pools.

mike: autoscale floor lowered to 1 probably caused underprovisioning in cheap pool when traffic shifted. combined with quantized kernel change in the variant -> increased memory pressure.

emma: agreed. mitigation: revert routing weights and bump cheap pool min replicas back to 2. Can someone run the kill-switch?

raj: I'm going to flip the feature flag to route back to stable-variant immediately. Flag path: `flags/inference/default-routing`. Command:
```
curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"inference.default_routing","value":"stable"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

jamie: done. flag flipped at 12:09. traffic steering reports show 80% -> stable-variant now. errors dropping.

oncall-bot: ACTION: feature-flag toggled by raj at 12:09. Annotated on incident.

linda: I still can't pull the variant latencies in Grafana because the dashboard panel wasn't provisioned by the release. We need to update the runbook: if panel missing, run Prom query `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{job=\"inference-router\", variant!=\"\"}[5m])) by (le, variant))`

mike: good call. I'll add that snippet to the incident notes.

emma: customer impact check: product reported 37 external 5xx events tied to premium accounts between 12:03-12:10. Can we confirm which customers?

raj: pulling traces — looks like a small set of high-traffic customers hit the cheap-variant due to stickiness bug (session routing ignored priority header for ~7 minutes). That's in the rollout diff too.

jamie: timeline: 12:03 deploy, 12:04 canary->20%, 12:05 autoscale floor drop effective, 12:06 sessions misrouted (priority header bug), 12:07 OOMs spike, 12:09 flag flip, 12:11 errors largely subsided.

linda: oncall handoff note: midnight eng-oncall will get a false sense of resolution if we don't record the dashboard gap. we should create a temporary dashboard tile now so next handoff has visibility.

mike: I can provision a quick grafana panel and link it in the incident. Doing `POST /api/dashboards/db` with a minimal JSON. will be up in ~3m.

emma: great. also, we didn't get an automated rollback because rollout auto-promote hit 100% fast. Can we add a safety to pause at 25% for 5m next time?

raj: adding a canary hold in the rollout config now in PR #4322. Also adding an alert to fail the rollout if variant OOMs > 5 within 5m.

jamie: runbook actions done: flag flipped, cheap pool min replicas bumped to 2, grafana panel provisioned: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/variant-latencies-temp (links only internal).

noncall-bot: UPDATE: incident severity lowered to Sev3 — customer impact limited, mitigation in progress.

emma: postmortem items (brief): 1) missing dashboard provisioning step in release checklist 2) rollout safety (pause at 25%) 3) autoscale floor change requires load test 4) add runbook snippet to Prom queries for missing panels 5) improve feature-flagging test for priority header stickiness.

mike: i'll own dashboard provisioning checklist update. deadline EOD.

raj: i'll own rollout safety and PR.

jamie: i'll own memory/regression tests for cheap-variant kernels.

linda: i'll write the customer impact summary and notify product for outreach.

emma: thanks all. leaving notes for next oncall: incident pinned in #incidents, runbook link attached, alert rule updated to route to oncall-sre if OOMs spike again.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • at 12:24 • incident:1999990001 • final state: mitigated, monitoring continue

emma: closing thread but keep the ticket open until postmortem lands. :white_check_mark:
